title: Part 2 Practice: Southeastern Highlands and Lowlands

options: A) West of the Rift Valley
B) East of the Rift Valley
questions.correct_answer: B) East of the Rift Valley
questions.explanation: The SOUTHEASTERN HIGHLANDS (Arsi, Bale, Sidama, Hararge) are located EAST of the Rift Valley. The WESTERN HIGHLANDS (Tigray, North Central Massifs, Shewa, SW Highlands) are WEST of the Rift Valley. The Rift Valley separates the two.

questions.text: The SECOND HIGHEST mountain in Ethiopia is:
questions.explanation: MOUNT BATU in the Bale Massifs is Ethiopia's second highest peak at 4,307 meters (after Ras Dashen at 4,550m). Mount Chilalo is in Arsi, Zuqualla is in Shewa, and Entoto is near Addis Ababa — all lower than Batu.

questions.text: Which highland is known for WHEAT and BARLEY production?
questions.explanation: ARSI HIGHLANDS are known for WHEAT and BARLEY production due to their high elevation (2000-4000m) and fertile volcanic soils. They also contain Mount Chilalo. Bale is known for forests, Sidama for coffee, Hararge for chat.

questions.text: The BALE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK is home to which endangered species?
questions.explanation: BALE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK is home to the ETHIOPIAN WOLF — one of the RAREST canines in the world and ENDEMIC to Ethiopia. The park also protects the Bale Massifs ecosystem. Mountain gorillas are in Central Africa, tigers in Asia.

SIDAMA HIGHLANDS are one of Ethiopia's most important COFFEE producing regions, famous for ARABICA coffee grown in fertile volcanic soils. Chat is associated with Hararge, wheat with Arsi, and gold mining with western regions.

questions.text: The historic city of HARAR is located on which plateau?
questions.explanation: HARAR (a UNESCO World Heritage city) is located on the HARARGE PLATEAU in eastern Ethiopia. The Hararge Plateau is composed of sandstone and limestone, and is known for CHAT (khat) production.

questions.text: The GENALLE PLAIN is drained by which river?
questions.explanation: The GHENALLE PLAIN is drained by the GHENALLE RIVER in southeastern Ethiopia (Somali region). The Wabishebelle Plain is drained by the Wabishebelle River. Awash and Omo drain other regions.

questions.text: The WABISHEBELLE RIVER is significant because it is:
options: A) The shortest river in Ethiopia
B) The longest river entirely within Ethiopia
C) A tributary of the Nile
questions.correct_answer: B) The longest river entirely within Ethiopia
questions.explanation: The WABISHEBELLE RIVER is the LONGEST river flowing ENTIRELY WITHIN Ethiopia's borders (about 1,200 km). The Abay (Blue Nile) is longer but flows into Sudan. Wabishebelle is vital for irrigation in the Somali region.

questions.text: The Southeastern Lowlands are primarily used for:
questions.explanation: The SEMI-ARID Southeastern Lowlands are primarily used for PASTORALISM (livestock herding — camels, cattle, goats) and IRRIGATION agriculture along river valleys (Ghenalle and Wabishebelle). Dense forests are in SW Highlands, rice paddies are rare, and industrial manufacturing is minimal.
